description: The plot titled “Training Loss of 20M Data Size” illustrates how training loss changes over training steps for multiple model variants trained on a 20M dataset. The x-axis is labeled “Step,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0k to 80k in the main panel with tick labels at 0k, 20k, 40k, 60k, and 80k; there is also a broken-axis continuation showing a later step range from about 420k to 440k with tick labels at 420k, 430k, and 440k. The y-axis is labeled “Train Loss,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0.0 up to about 0.85, with labeled ticks including 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.75, and 0.85. Six thin solid lines without markers are shown: a red line (ChemBART Small 20M) starts near the upper range around ~0.8 at the earliest steps, drops steeply within the first few thousand steps, then continues decreasing more gradually to around ~0.10 by ~80k, and appears around ~0.04–0.06 in the 420k–440k segment; a blue line (legend label obscured in the image) follows a similar pattern, beginning near ~0.8, decreasing rapidly early, reaching roughly ~0.09–0.11 by ~80k, and sitting around ~0.04–0.06 in the 420k–440k segment; a green line (ChemBERTa Small 20M) begins near ~0.8, declines quickly early, then trends downward more slowly to about ~0.11–0.13 by ~80k, and is around ~0.05–0.07 in the 420k–440k segment; an orange line (ChemBERTa Medium 20M) starts near ~0.8, drops sharply early, then decreases to roughly ~0.09–0.11 by ~80k, and appears around ~0.04–0.06 in the 420k–440k segment; a purple line (ChemLLaMA Small 20M) begins near ~0.8, falls rapidly early, then gradually declines to about ~0.07–0.09 by ~80k, and is around ~0.03–0.05 in the 420k–440k segment; and a brown line (ChemLLaMA Medium 20M) also starts near ~0.8, decreases steeply at the beginning, then continues downward to roughly ~0.06–0.08 by ~80k, and appears around ~0.03–0.05 in the 420k–440k segment.
